subject: Writing a cron job in Shinyapps

messages.author: 6283a9ce7dd2c642
messages.subject: Writing a cron job in Shinyapps
parts:
I understand that the shinyapps live on an AWS Centos server. I'd like that server to run a cron job every night that refreshes the app's data by querying the client's database. 

The query, and the resulting data cleaning & csv writing is all written in R. I just want the server to run that R script at 1am every morning (or thereabouts).

Question is, how do I set up the cron job on the shinyapp server? Question 2 is, if that can't be done, is there a better way to implement this?

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Writing a cron job in Shinyapps
parts:
Hi Jake,
Unfortunately shinyapps.io doesn't have a mechanism for scheduling execution of work.  It is one of those ideas we have been considering but hadn't seen enough demand for. You are the second person to bring it up in the past 24 hours so perhaps the idea is gaining more momentum now.  Right now, your best bet would like be to run the code on a machine that you can schedule the work on (example crontab) and push the resulting data to a place that is accessible from shinyapps.io (dropbox, S3, or a database like Redshift).  Once we add support for persistent storage, and scheduling it will be a much simpler process to do what you want to do.

-Tareef
